content: User feedback for LLM apps: explicit feedback (thumbs up/down, 1-5 stars) has low response rates - users must act. Binary reduces cognitive load, larger datasets, better for algorithms; but no neutral/mediocre option. Stars better for nuanced decisions. Best practice: keep collection simple/non-intrusive; for expert users move beyond binary to structured feedback. Langfuse/Helicone attach scores to trace/generation id.
